hooks.name: Verify output, not just exit code
hooks.description: Before running a simulation or benchmark command, reminds the agent to verify real output rather than treating a zero exit code as success.

action.prompt: If this command runs a SUMO simulation, the server, or compare.py, remember the project rule: a zero exit code is not proof of success. Check the actual output — vehicles inserted, metrics that differ between strategies, or files written — before reporting the task done.
